thread:
Nina (CS): Hey team — Helix Labs signed up for the beta but we still need final enrollment confirmation and a short enablement. Can we sync up?
Ravi (CSM): I emailed their main contact yesterday, no reply yet. They mentioned end-of-quarter bandwidth.
Nina (CS): OK. Risk: if they don't attend enablement, renewal conversations get tricky. Suggest a 30-min recorded + live Q&A slot next Tue. Thoughts? :calendar:
Eli (Solutions): We should gate their workspace by feature-flag until they've completed the enablement prework. Keeps support overhead low.
Oliver (PM): Agreed. Which prework? Quick checklist is enough: 1) invite engineers, 2) share sample data, 3) set up API key.
Nina (CS): I'll draft the checklist and schedule the invite. Anyone want to own the data ingestion doc?
Eli (Solutions): I can do the data doc. I'll include a minimal curl example and a sandbox payload.
Ravi (CSM): I'll follow up on the calendar invite and try a CTA from the exec sponsor to increase attendance.
OnboardBot: Reminder: Beta enrollment form incomplete for Helix Labs (1 required field missing: billing contact).
Nina (CS): Thanks bot — Ravi can you ping them for billing contact? We need it for seat allocations.
Ravi (CSM): On it. Quick note: they initially requested 25 seats but only have 6 engineers listed. Should we provision 25 or scale to 10 for now?
Nina (CS): Scale to 10. We can expand after kickoff. Put a note on renewal risk if adoption < 50% in first 30 days.
Oliver (PM): I'll add a small in-app NPS prompt after week 2 targeted at beta users — helps capture early feedback.
Eli (Solutions): For the kickoff, here's the minimal snippet I'll share in the doc:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/deploy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -d '{"sample": "payload"}'
```
Nina (CS): Perfect. I'll send a calendar with the agenda and prework link. Also tagging @Oliver to confirm PM attendance.
Oliver (PM): I'll join the live Q&A. If they can't make live, we'll send the recording and require watching before escalation.
Ravi (CSM): Update: billing contact replied — forwarding now. Also they confirmed engineers: 6, product: 2, ops: 1. I'll update seat list.
Nina (CS): Great. Action items recap:
- Nina: schedule 30-min kickoff, send checklist + prework link
- Ravi: finalize seat roster, chase exec sponsor for attendance
- Eli: publish data ingestion doc + curl example
- Oliver: PM to run Q&A and set up NPS prompt
- OnboardBot: mark billing contact complete and open provisioning task
Ravi (CSM): I'll mark provisioning for 10 seats after Nina's invite goes out.
Nina (CS): Final ask — attach any customer-specific notes in the thread so CS handoff after week 2 is clean. I'll follow up on adoption metrics at day 14. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Oliver (PM): Adding note — watch for model hallucination reports; product will triage if flagged.
Eli (Solutions): I'll also put a short troubleshooting checklist in the doc for common onboarding issues.
Nina (CS): Thanks all — closing loop after invites are sent. :thumbsup:
